tasks.label: Docker QA Build & Run
tasks.command: docker rm -f regie-qa 2>/dev/null; docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && docker build -t uni-recruitment-app:qa . && docker run --rm --name regie-qa --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway --env-file .env -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:password@host.docker.internal:5433/recruitment -e SMTP_HOST=host.docker.internal -e NODE_ENV=production -p 3000:3000 uni-recruitment-app:qa
